provenance.note: NOT SCORED — see gauges.config.json's unscoredReason and this gauge's own page for why. Entered by hand from the two Gallup news-release articles that publish this index's country tables (no data product exists): (1) news.gallup.com/poll/216377/new-index-shows-least-accepting-countries-migrants.aspx, the 2016/17 wave's full ranked table (138 countries surveyed in 2016; the U.S. surveyed in 2017 specifically, per the article's own footnote) — 8 of 9 peers present (Canada absent: the article states 'Canada will be surveyed later in 2017', never entered this wave's table). (2) news.gallup.com/poll/320678/world-grows-less-accepting-migrants.aspx, the 2019 update — NOT a full table, only a global top-10 list, so only 4 of 9 peers appear (Canada, New Zealand, Australia, United States). The other 5 peers (UK, Germany, Japan, Netherlands, South Korea) are not published in either article — confirmed by reading both in full, not inferred from a gap. Every value below is transcribed verbatim from the cited article's own table; none estimated or interpolated.
